cohort: The study included 57 parturient patients undergoing cesarean section from a total of 2,206 incident reports of adverse events from 333,219 cases reported to the Perioperative Anesthetic Adverse Events in Thailand (PAAd Thai) registry.
finding: Inexperience, haste, and inadequate knowledge were the major contributing factors to perioperative anesthetic adverse events in patients undergoing cesarean section, and some of these events were preventable.
